name: Tacky Pine Sap
text:
You conjure highly flammable pine sap, covering the area with it. This area becomes difficult terrain. When a creature within the area uses a fire effect or receives fire damage, the sap ignites, dealing floor@item.rank /2d6 persistent,fire damage to anyone standing on it; this burns up the sap, removing it and its difficult terrain.

---
Heightened (+2) The persistent fire damage increases by 1d6.
